title: Skills use commands every shell parses
goal: No SKILL.md runs a command with an environment prefix or bare curl: kb-git-sync continues a rebase with git -c core.editor=true, kb-census adds KB-Verified with git commit --trailer, kb-setup tests reachability with curl.exe; git.md shows the --trailer form first.
notes: Today: kb-git-sync section 2 step 3 (GIT_EDITOR=true git -c merge.conflictStyle=diff3 rebase --continue), kb-census (KB_VERIFIED=<date> on commits), kb-setup step 4 (curl -sI; in Windows PowerShell 5.1 curl is an alias of Invoke-WebRequest and -sI fails). kb-research's rg, sed and cat run in the Bash tool (Git Bash) only; say so rather than rewrite them.
